home.title: CrystalSteps Studio — Useful mobile apps
home.description: CrystalSteps builds free, practical apps for everyday life — from mindful shopping with Clariguiz to exploring monuments with Monumente.
home.heroBody: We design simple, privacy-minded mobile apps that help you shop smarter and explore the world around you.
home.clariguizCard: Scan food, beauty and pet products. Get a clear 0–100 score from Nutri-Score, NOVA, MUM and SIGA.
home.monumenteCard: Explore monuments, museums and points of interest near you, in real time.

clariguiz.title: Clariguiz — Food, beauty & pet scanner
clariguiz.description: Scan barcodes and get a 0–100 score based on Nutri-Score, NOVA, MUM and SIGA. Free, no account. Food, beauty and pet food.
clariguiz.heroBody: Scan a barcode and get a 0–100 score from several systems together — Nutri-Score, NOVA, MUM and SIGA — so you see nutritional quality and processing level, not just a single grade.
what: Food: ingredients, additives, ultra-processed foods and overall quality
Beauty & personal care: INCI analysis
Pet food: dedicated scoring for your animals
Profiles: Balanced, Diabetic, Sports, Clean
why: Interpolated score — more reliable than one indicator alone
Detects ultra-processed products
Pet food included
Free, no account, no personal data collected
Data from Open Food / Beauty / Product Facts

monumente.title: Monumente — Discover monuments & museums nearby
monumente.description: Explore monuments, museums and historical points of interest around you. Your multilingual cultural guide. Free.
monumente.heroBody: Turn your phone into a cultural companion: find monuments, museums and points of interest in your surroundings in real time.
what: Nearby monuments, museums and points of interest
Real-time discovery while you walk
Built for curious travelers, art lovers and history fans
Multilingual cultural guide
why: Instant context for the places you pass
Simple and free to use
Made by CrystalSteps Studio
